description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Yerwel Nepol)
- Vendor B (Sogartal Movokbel)
- Vendor C (Negar Nethoans)
- Vendor D (Momirke Ozlyn)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Yerwel Nepol):
  - Vendor A offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor A supports standard interoperability formats
  - Vendor A has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor A has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor A quoted a total cost of 311 thousand per year
Vendor B (Sogartal Movokbel):
  - Vendor B imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor B has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor B uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor B provides no staff training
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 15 months
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 312 thousand per year
Vendor C (Negar Nethoans):
  - Vendor C has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor C refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor C provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor C quoted a total cost of 611 thousand per year
Vendor D (Momirke Ozlyn):

  - Vendor D has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor D has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor D currently serves 50 hospital clients
  - Vendor D estimates deployment will take 4 months
